disclosure: Frozen while full run was in progress, without inspecting any full-run timing values. Earlier pilot results and budget were known; neither this supplement nor the base is a pre-run registration.
image_and_question_identity: For each task and measured group, require exactly one identical accepted DEV qid, group_id, image content identity and prompt identity across all three configurations, both protocols and all five distinct replicate IDs. Bind run schedule and accepted E1 input/reference proof and digests. Fail closed for missing, duplicate, changed or conflicting identity; count groups, not questions or repeats as independent units.
uncertainty_scope: Bootstrap draws same image groups jointly with all five observed repeats and all configurations/protocols. It represents variation from sampled image groups conditional on this run and its observed repeated measurements. It does not separately estimate within-image measurement noise, temporal load drift, other host-process effects, between-run variability, or changes in hardware/software; confidence intervals do not remedy these limitations.
time_semantics: Validate each accepted event has the same declared monotonic clock and time namespace as its verified worker and compatible health windows, integer timestamps, t0 before image read, first chosen-token timestamp, and generation completion; require t0 < first_token <= generation_complete and a strictly positive finite ratio denominator. Missing, reversed, zero, incompatible or semantically unproven endpoints cause analysis failure, not sample deletion. TTFT includes the boundary sync; end-to-end is not logits-ready, prefill-only or decode-only, and natural output lengths may differ.
interference_unknown: Keep every accepted sample, including overlapped samples. Report complete supervisor windows and each manual full-check window, plus an NVML subwindow only when an actual query was recorded. Explicit null NVML denotes no extra NVML query, not an unknown query. Missing/incomplete/incompatible monitoring intervals are unknown and must fail closed or be reported as unclassifiable; they must never become false/no-overlap. The approx 07:03:30 journal/status scans lack exact monotonic bounds and cannot be assigned exactly to samples. Manual health logging after the recorded end and possible effects before/after any window remain unmeasured.
actions: Write no analysis result before full formal and independent acceptance with clean exits. Do not alter base plan, frozen timing code or delete any sample.
